```json
[
  {"input": "1", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "2", "output": "1"},
  {"input": "15", "output": "4"},
  {"input": "27", "output": "7"},
  {"input": "32", "output": "8"},
  {"input": "100", "output": "13"},
  {"input": "1000", "output": "41"},
  {"input": "4096", "output": "82"},
  {"input": "999999", "output": "1110"},
  {"input": "1000000", "output": "1111"}
]
```

These were checked by hand with the Möbius formula: the count is 1 + Σ_{k≥2} −μ(k)·(⌊N^{1/k}⌋ − 1). The 1 accounts for 1 = 1². For example, N=1000 gives 30 + 9 + 2 + 1 − 2 − 1 = 39 non-unit powers, plus 1, for 40 + 1 = 41. The formula also reproduces both sample outputs (99 → 12).
